svg.title: Ezekiel's river
svg.desc: An illustrated plate of Ezekiel 47:1-12. Above, a scene from the temple on its mountain down to the Dead Sea, with numbered callouts: 1, water issues from below the threshold toward the east (Ezekiel 47:1); 2 to 5, at each thousand cubits the river is ankle-deep, knee-deep, waist-deep, and then deep enough to swim in, a river that cannot be crossed (Ezekiel 47:3-5); 6, very many trees on both banks, with fruit every month and leaves for healing (Ezekiel 47:7, 12); 7, the river goes down into the Arabah and the sea becomes fresh (Ezekiel 47:8); 8, fishermen spread nets from Engedi to Eneglaim (Ezekiel 47:10); 9, the swamps and marshes are left for salt (Ezekiel 47:11). A dashed note says the river's course is not mapped and Eneglaim's site is not known. Below, a strip shows the four depths on a standing figure at 1,000, 2,000, 3,000 and 4,000 cubits. Beside it, Revelation 22:1-2: the river of the water of life from the throne of God and of the Lamb, the tree of life on either side, and no sea (Revelation 21:1). The plate closes with Ezekiel 47:9: everything will live where the river goes.
svg.text: Ezekiel 47:1-12, from the threshold to the sea
“water was issuing from below the threshold of the temple toward the east”
Four thousand: “deep enough to swim in, a river that could not be passed through”
“very many trees on the one side and on the other” · “their leaves for healing”
“goes down into the Arabah, and enters the sea… the water will become fresh”
“Fishermen will stand beside the sea. From Engedi to Eneglaim”
“its swamps and marshes will not become fresh; they are to be left for salt”
Not stated: the river's course between the house and the Arabah. Eneglaim's site is
not known (the best proposed site scores 120 of 1000 in OpenBible.info).
THE RISE · A THOUSAND CUBITS AT A TIME
No tributary is named. The water rises from the threshold alone.
“the river of the water of life, bright as crystal,
flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb”
“on either side of the river, the tree of life… The leaves
of the tree were for the healing of the nations”
No sea is drawn: “the sea was no more” (Revelation 21:1).
“And wherever the river goes, every living creature that swarms will live…
so everything will live where the river goes.”
After the manner of Clarence Larkin · the-way.lewy.au
